document_title: Cryptocurrency Technical Analysis Tools & BOTs Development
summary: A bachelor thesis describing the development of a web application and automated trading bot for cryptocurrencies, using technical analysis indicators (MACD, RSI) on the Binance platform. The bot specifically trades ADA (Cardano) against USDT. The thesis covers AWS deployment, algorithm design, and backtesting of strategies. No actionable market-moving events are identified; the report is a technical development description, not an investment thesis.

events.title: Bot development for ADA/USDT automated trading on Binance
events.body: The thesis describes building a BOT that automatically exchanges between USDT and ADA on Binance using MACD and RSI technical indicators. Users can select indicators after checking profitability.
